name: @yottameta/yotta-learn
description: Yuanxi — a cross-agent knowledge-base skill: turns reusable experience, methods, pitfalls and tutorials into categorized, indexed, keyword-searchable KB entries (draft → review → verified) that any agent can read and write via CLI, MCP (stdio), or the local-only web console (view); guides first-run activation and auto-connects MCP. Triggers when knowledge should be captured (command failure / user correction / a better approach / stale knowledge / a missing capability / an external-interface failure) or queried (before starting work / before solving a non-obvious problem). Boundaries: private or sensitive info never goes into the shared KB (use yotta-memory); project-specific experience goes into the project's own files; never auto-modifies system files.

scripts.test: node --test "test/*.test.js" && python scripts/test_yotta_learn.py && python scripts/test_yotta_learn_help.py && python scripts/test_yotta_kb.py && python scripts/test_yotta_learn_mcp.py && python scripts/test_yotta_learn_view.py
